content: node-pty runs in Electron main process (or a dedicated Node utility process); pty.node native binding must be unpacked from asar (asarUnpack). Renderer uses xterm.js; data flows PTY stdout -> main process -> ipcMain.on/webContents.send -> renderer, and keystrokes flow renderer -> ipcRenderer.send -> main -> pty.write. Avoid synchronous IPC (ipcRenderer.sendSync) for high-frequency terminal data; use async send/streams. Multiple concurrent terminals are simply multiple pty.spawn instances tracked in a Map keyed by session id.
